Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying trench excavations on public works projects provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to trench excavations on public works projects; andamending RCW 39.04.180.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 39.04.180 and 1988 c 180 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((On)) A contract for any public works project((s)) in which atrench excavation will exceed a depth of four feet((, any contracttherefor)) shall require adequate safety systems ((for the trenchexcavation)) that meet the requirements of the Washington industrialsafety and health act, chapter 49.17 RCW. ((This requirement shall beincluded in the cost estimates and bidding forms as a separate item.The costs of trench safety systems shall not be considered asincidental to any other contract item and any attempt to include thetrench safety systems as an incidental cost is prohibited.))
